meta.name: wjs-looping-feedback
meta.description: Use when the user wants to add an in-site feedback loop to a website repo — a floating "提个建议" button where allowlisted visitors submit suggestions that become a GitHub Issue, which GitHub Actions turns into an automatic code change via Claude Code, auto-merges and deploys, and records on a /_feedback dashboard with one-click revert. Triggers — "给网站加个反馈对话框", "提一句话就自动改网站", "装上反馈闭环", "feedback loop", "/wjs-looping-feedback".

copy.tagline: 给网站加上反馈按钮，自动将建议转为代码并部署
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望访客提建议后网站能自动更新并上线。
